Class BswDistinguishedPartition Package M2::AUTOSARTemplates::BswModuleTemplate::BswBehavior Note Each instance of this meta-class represents an abstract partition in which context the code of the enclosing BswModuleBehavior can be executed. The intended use case is to distinguish between several partitions in order to implement different behavior per partition, for example to behave either as a master or satellite in a multicore ECU with shared BSW code.
